__1 To finish. 
__2 To leave unfinished. 
__3 To go, move. 
__4 To be idle or lazy (शठयति). 
__5 To deceive, cheat. 
__6 To speak ill of.

€10U. (साठयति-ते) 
__1 To finish, complete. 
__2 To leave unfinished. 
__3 To go, move. 
__4 To adorn, decorate.

a. [शठ्-अच्] 
__1 Crafty, deceitful, fraudulent, dishonest, perfidious. 
__2 Wicked, depraved. 
-ठः 
__1 A rogue, cheat, knave, swindler; [[Ms. 4. 30]]; [[Bg. 18. 28.]] 
__2 A false or deceitful lover (who pretends to love one woman while his heart is fixed on another); ध्रुवमस्मि शठः शुचिस्मिते विदितः कैतवबत्सलस्तव [[R. 8. 49]]; 19. 31; शठ इति मयि तावदस्तु ते परिचयवत्यवधीरणा प्रिये [[M. 3. 19]]; (the [[S. D.]] thus defines a शठः--शठोऽयमेकत्र बद्धभावो यः । दर्शितबहिरनुरागो विप्रियमन्यत्र गूढमाचरति ॥ 74). 
__3 A fool, blockhead. 
__4 A mediator, arbitrator. 
__5 The Dhattūra plant. 
__6 An idler, a lazy fellow. 
-ठम् 
__1 Iron. 
__2 Saffron. 
-Comp. 
-उदर्क a. deceitful in the end.

[शठस्य भावः ष्यञ्] 
___(a) Dishonesty, perfidy, guile; trickery, fraud, villainy; आजन्मनः शाठ्यमशिक्षितो यः [[Ś. 5. 25]]; दाक्षिण्यं स्वजने दया परजने शाठ्यं सदा दुर्जने [[Bh. 2. 22.]] 
___(b) Art, skill, cunning; देव्या निह्नोतुमिच्छेरिति सुरसरितं शाठ्यमव्याद्विभोर्वः [[Mu. 1. 1.]]
